name: Gyaku Oudou
source:
"The School Ranch Project".

When I entered this seemingly ordinary school, where I had the impression that many of the students were the sons and daughters of wealthy families, I had no idea that such a dangerous plan was underway. A ranch may sound like a tranquil place, but this is not the case with this project. The livestock they are going to raise there is none other than the students themselves - or, to be more precise, female students.

It was only recently that I, Ryuji Nozaki, learned of this plan along with the secret of my birth. When my mother told me that his father, whom I had been told was “dead” for so long, was actually alive, I honestly thought, “Oh, so that's true after all,” and was not that surprised.

However, when I found out that my father was the head of the foundation that supported the management of the school and a resident of the underworld who was promoting this illegal project, I could not help but be astonished. Why did she suddenly reveal my father's existence and tell me such a thing?

The answer was that I had been chosen as the heir apparent to my father. My father, whom I had never met before, was an unparalleled lover of women, and in addition to my mother, he had had relations with a number of women, some of whom had fathered children. Somehow I had caught his attention. 

As a result, I was suddenly made aware of my hidden identity and told that it would be a good idea if I were enrolled in the school, and entrusted with the promotion of this “school ranching project". Suddenly, my daily life at the school has changed completely. But perhaps it is because of my bloodline. Amid this darkening world, I was strangely driven by a destructive impulse and felt myself enveloped in a unique sense of elation.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.turumiku.jp/gyaku_h/]game's website[/url]]
translation:
“学校牧场项目”。

当我进入这所看似普通的学校时，我的印象是这里的学生很多都是富家子弟，但我不知道如此危险的计划正在进行中。牧场听起来像是一个宁静的地方，但这个项目的情况并非如此。他们要在那里饲养的牲畜不是别人，正是学生们自己——或者更准确地说，是女学生们。

直到最近，我野崎龙二才知道了这个计划以及我出生的秘密。当我母亲告诉我，他的父亲（我一直被告知“死了”这么久）实际上还活着时，我真诚地想，“哦，这毕竟是真的”，并没有那么惊讶。

然而，当我发现我的父亲是支持学校管理的基金会的负责人，也是推动这个非法项目的黑社会居民时，我不禁感到惊讶。为什么她会突然透露我父亲的存在，并告诉我这样的事情？

答案是我被选为我父亲的法定继承人。我以前从未见过的父亲是一位无与伦比的女性情人，除了我母亲之外，他还与许多女性发生过关系，其中一些女性还生了孩子。不知怎的，我引起了他的注意。

结果，我突然知道了自己隐藏的身份，并被告知如果我能入读该校就好了，并委托我负责推广这个“学校牧场工程”。突然之间，我在学校的日常生活完全改变了。但或许是因为我的血统吧。在这个黑暗的世界里，我奇怪地被一种破坏性的冲动所驱使，并感到自己被一种独特的兴高采烈的感觉所笼罩。

[翻译自[url=http://www.turumiku.jp/gyaku_h/]游戏的网站[/url]]
